subject: general
question: Which Indian classical dance form has composition in Meitei language?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manipuri** is one of the major Indian classical dance forms that originated in the northeastern Indian state of **Manipur**.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in the **Vaishnavite traditions** and is influenced by the **spiritual themes of Lord Krishna and Radha.**
 
• Compositions in **Meitei language**, the primary language spoken in Manipur, are an integral part of Manipuri dance performances.
 
• It is characterized by its **graceful movements**, **soft hand gestures**, and the use of unique costumes like the traditional **Kumil** (long skirts).
 
• Manipuri dance involves themes from the **Raas Leela**, representing the divine love between Radha and Krishna, and other mythological stories.
 
• The dance form is known for its **delicate and lyrical expression**, making it distinct from other Indian classical dances.
 
• It is performed during important festivals like **Janmashtami** and **Rath Yatra** in Manipur.
 
• Manipuri dance emphasizes a strong connection between **spirituality** and **artistic expression**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sattriya**__

 __
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form from **Assam**, introduced by the Vaishnavite saint **Sankaradeva** in the 15th century.
 
• It is performed in **Sattras** (monastic institutions) and revolves around themes related to **Lord Krishna**.
 
• It is unique for its combination of **music, drama, and dance** in storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Chhau**__
 __
 
• **Chhau** is a semi-classical dance form practiced in the eastern states of **India**, including **Odisha, West Bengal, and Jharkhand**.
 
• It is known for its strong **martial movements**, use of masks in certain styles, and themes drawn from **epics like Mahabharata and Ramayana**.
 
• Chhau is not traditionally performed in Meitei language but uses local dialects and Sanskrit verses in its compositions.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**__
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance forms from **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• Its compositions are primarily in languages like **Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada**.
 
• Bharatanatyam is renowned for its intricate **footwork**, **expressive gestures**, and **spiritual themes**.
